Base conversion: texture rebinding and GLB conversion, original geometry retained.
Moon modification: project-authored material colors and witch hat. The hat is
project-owned, not a third-party asset and not newly released under CC0.
The game uses base-motion-v7.glb and moon-motion-v7.glb. Each GLB
contains the Camp_* clips used by the character controller. The earlier
static previews and their textures are preserved in Git commit 26da01f.
The downloaded MMD archives in output/character-library are NOT these assets
and are NOT included or cleared for commercial game distribution.
